satellites.title: The Three Trainings
satellites.evidence: The Śūraṅgama Sūtra: 攝心為戒，因戒生定，因定發慧，是則名為三無漏學 — “gathering the mind is discipline; from discipline arises concentration; from concentration, wisdom: these are called the three untainted trainings.”
satellites.caveat: Many scholars hold the Śūraṅgama to be a Chinese composition of the early eighth century; the triad śīla, samādhi, prajñā is far older.
